entities.summary: Glenn David Williams is a retired third baseman from Australia, who played in the Minnesota Twins organization. He played in Major League Baseball for the Twins during the 2005 season. He was a member of the Australia national team that won the silver medal at the 2004 Summer Olympics in Athens, Greece.
